purpose: Teach: 倉敷/ストライク/ワルツ/アイアン/鉄筋/蝋/シンデレラ/タンゴ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと倉敷の美観地区に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go with Dad to see the Kurashiki historic district, all right?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Slight lift at the end like a shared adventure. Gentle pacing, the rhythm of an offer rather than a command. A mother's hand extended.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、野球部でストライク三振しちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I struck out at baseball practice today.
lines.style: Quiet admission without drama. Matter-of-fact delivery masking the small sting underneath. Pause before the confession, like he's prepared for her reaction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ワルツの音楽でゆったり踊りましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's dance a slow waltz together to some music, hmm?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle redirection. Not avoiding what he said, but offering something else. Soft and steady, like she's known exactly what he needed to hear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとゴルフのアイアンの練習したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I practiced golf irons together.
lines.style: Brighter now. Small pride in the accomplishment. His voice lifts slightly on the memory. Still reserved but the pleasure is there, quiet and genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい家は鉄筋造りで地震に強いのよ
lines.en: Sho, our new house has reinforced concrete construction — it's very safe from earthquakes.
lines.style: Reassuring without being obvious about it. Factual but tender underneath. The cadence of a mother thinking ahead, protecting what matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お誕生日の蝋燭がたくさんだったね
lines.en: Mom, I had so many candles on my birthday cake.
lines.style: Wonder and delight in his voice. A small, genuine laugh. The specific memory vivid and warm. Not boastful — just moved by the abundance of it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんとシンデレラの絵本を読みましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's read Cinderella with Mom tonight, shall we?
lines.style: Gentle invitation. The familiar comfort of ritual. Her voice warm and present, holding space for him. An anchor point after everything said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがお母さんとタンゴ踊ってる姿、素敵だったよ
lines.en: Mom, it was lovely watching Dad and you dance the tango together.
lines.style: Soft, sincere observation. Not performing emotion — just speaking something true he noticed. Quiet wonder that adults he loves were beautiful together. No shyness, just honesty.
